description.la: Epistulae Augustini 141–175, quae in versione Anglica non exstant. Textus Latinus.
description.en-US: 20 of Augustine's letters (141 to 175), Latin text of the Maurist edition (with the post-Maurist additions of Divjak, Dolbeau and others where the source numbers them). These are the letters not in the English NPNF book; no English translation imported.
description.pt-BR: 20 cartas de Santo Agostinho (141 a 175), texto latino da edição dos Maurinos e dos acréscimos posteriores.

sources.edition: Maurist text (Benedictines of Saint-Maur, 1679-1700) as printed in Migne, Patrologia Latina, on augustinus.it (Corpus Augustinianum Gissense / NBA Latin pages)
sources.description: Latin pages lettere of augustinus.it, one page per book, long pages split at chapter boundaries. The Italian NBA headings, summaries and biblical-reference notes are dropped; section numbers and italicised quotations are kept. Raw mirror in research/sourcing/augustine-latin/raw.
sources.tierEvidence: Text of a 4th-5th-century work in the Maurist edition (1679-1700, Migne 1841-49), long public domain.
